verdict.rationale: Factory offers a hosted Factory App/API that creates and manages Droid sessions (factory-docs-13, factory-docs-23) which suggests some cloud-side session orchestration without a developer standing up their own backend, and the Sessions API/Software Factory dashboard imply managed infrastructure. However, the docs explicitly describe a 'Bring Your Own Machine' model where users register their own VPS/workstation/on-prem server for compute (factory-docs-24), suggesting execution often still depends on user-managed infrastructure rather than a fully Factory-hosted compute layer. Missing for 10: explicit description of a fully managed, Factory-hosted compute/runtime option (vs. BYOM), and independent confirmation that no backend operation is required by the developer.
